verdict.rationale: New Relic's official CLI is documented for use in CI/CD pipelines. It supports machine-readable JSON/YAML output, credential profiles that apply to any command, and automatable actions such as recording deployment markers. Terraform adds declarative, headless management of agent fleets. missing for 10: explicit docs on non-interactive CI authentication (e.g., API-key env vars) and exit-code behavior, independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The New Relic CLI enables the integration of New Relic into your existing workflows. Be it fetching data from your laptop while troubleshooting an issue, or adding New Relic into your CI/CD pipeline.
--format string    output text format [JSON, Text, YAML] (default "JSON")
Profiles contain credentials and settings that you can apply to any CLI command
Deployment Markers: Easily record an APM Application deployment within New Relic.
Terraform provides a powerful, declarative solution for managing fleets of agents at scale.
